title: Closing the Loop: Train, Prune, Recover, and Re-evaluate
analysis: The dense toy classifier reached 93.2%. One-shot 70% pruning changed validation accuracy immediately to 90.5% and recovered to 91.4% after 36 updates. The staged route finished at 91.4% with 70.0% zeros under the same update budget. This isolates the support trajectory on one synthetic task; it is not a universal schedule ranking.
conclusion: A pruning result is a trajectory with a support constraint and recovery budget, not a mask applied once.
